calls.action: Read .pilot/pilot-process.md, pilot-link-existing-analysis.md, pilot-link-ticket-tree.md, pilot-link-agent-dialogue.md and pilot-link-roster.md; confirm --human with a raw idea (no --multi, no --resume).
Determine input: raw idea 'Let travelers save a place as a favorite.' It is a product idea (not tech/bug), so continue without analyzing it myself.
Fetch open level:epic issues (title and body) via list_issues/search_issues; none exist, so the candidate list is empty.

Call Agent pilot-pm with pilot-task-analyze-existing.md, the analysis-cycle link in full, the raw idea and the (empty) Epic list; keep the analysis in the conversation and show the human its 'Touched by this input' and 'Not covered' parts.
With --human, ask the human once for their proposal: one story or several, the Epic, acceptance criteria and decisions they already hold.

Call Agent pilot-pm with pilot-task-frame-idea.md (raw idea, Epic list, framing conversation with the human's answers); show the PM's challenges and restated brief conversationally, with provisional defaults where useful.

Feed the human's replies back and call the PM again, repeating rounds until the brief is ready and confirmed (or the human accepts the provisional defaults). If out of scope or not a product idea, report and create nothing.

Call Agent pilot-pm with pilot-task-write-story.md, the analysis-cycle link, the analysis, the validated brief and raw idea, the empty Epic list and the human's proposal; the PM writes it up and challenges it without adding decisions of its own.

Call Agent pilot-architect with pilot-task-anticipate-architecture.md, the analysis-cycle link, pilot-link-knowledge.md and pilot-link-architecture.md in full (architecture module on), the analysis and the draft only, to validate and anticipate the architecture.

If the architect objects, run the PM/architect/human dialogue per pilot-link-agent-dialogue.md turn-taking, putting any question that needs the human to them before anything is created, until convergence (single story, tech companion, or several stories plus Epic, or out of scope: stop and create nothing).

Create the draft ticket(s) with issue_write: type:feature, level:story, status:draft, priority, assigned to this session (plus a type:tech companion or new Epic with sub_issue_write if the dialogue decided so). Then record the 'created' events with pilot.py event --action created --phase discovery (best-effort).

Show the human the drafted story and the anticipated architecture with real issue numbers; put the PM's remaining open questions to them; ask once whether they have a mockup, want to sketch one, or accept the PM's prose description (user-facing UI); check ticket comments for attachments.

Feed corrections back into the dialogue and write each round's changes into the draft ticket(s) via issue_write, repeating until the human approves (if out of scope: set status:wont-do and close the draft instead).
Final consolidation pass: the dialogue re-reads each draft ticket body as a whole and fixes any incoherence across rounds.
Finalize: python3 .pilot/pilot.py set <n> --status backlog --unassign for each story (no --from-proto, so no prototype handling).

Dashboard (dashboardUrl is set): get the events from pilot.py event <n>... --action approved --phase discovery and push them, together with the 'created' ones, via ArtifactData (ToolSearch if deferred); best-effort.

Wiki module on: call Agent pilot-pm with pilot-task-wiki-entries.md (target status proposed, project language from pilot.py module list, knowledge and wiki links, the finalized story, domains touched) for each type:feature story.
Put each 'conflicts' question from the PM to the human and settle it before applying anything.

On branch wiki/discovery-<first story n>, apply add/update/remove with pilot.py wiki add/set, run wiki lint, commit (docs(wiki): ..., with Co-Authored-By and Claude-Session trailers), push, open one PR listing the entries and status (with the Claude Code attribution footer), and give the human its link to merge. Never merge it.
Report the story issue number(s)/URL(s) and the wiki PR link to the human.
Read .pilot/pilot-process.md, pilot-link-existing-analysis.md, pilot-link-ticket-tree.md, pilot-link-agent-dialogue.md and pilot-link-roster.md; note --human mode (no --multi, no --resume).

Final consolidation pass: have the dialogue re-read each whole draft body and fix inconsistencies across rounds.
Finalize: pilot.py set <n> --status backlog --unassign for each story (no --from-proto, so no prototype update).

Dashboard (dashboardUrl is set): get events from pilot.py event <n>... --action approved --phase discovery (and the created ones from step 4) and push them with ArtifactData (ToolSearch to load it if deferred), best-effort.

Wiki module on: for each finalized type:feature story, call Agent pilot-pm with pilot-task-wiki-entries.md (target status proposed), project language, knowledge and wiki links, the story and domains; put any conflicts questions to the human and settle them.
